## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      22 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 08.06.2026 - 15.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _AverageMean_, 13.09.2026, 1/5: "used to love the app but its filled with bugs (apps not blocking or blocking in loops when unblocked, spamming notifications…) since the 4.x update :( is there any way to get the old app back?"
            2. _lupercaia_, 25.08.2026, 1/5: "i really loved it first, but then the app started working worse and worse. first, some blocks that i set up started duplicating - meaning you had to unblock it twice. then some blocks started showing up on wrong times - like block that’s scheduled for weekdays on Saturday. Then unblocking the blocks became very easy and short for whatever reason?? My final straw was just now when I received the very same push notification frim them TEN TIMES IN A ROW. It used to be a great app, but it’s broken now."
            3. _S.ley1'_, 04.08.2026, 1/5: "The app glitches. Sometimes it blocks outside block moments and then doesn't unblock or the app completely malfunctions."
